books.title: The Alchemist
books.author: Paulo Coelho
books.description: The story follows Santiago, a young shepherd who travels from Spain to Egypt in search of hidden treasure. Along the journey, he discovers the importance of following dreams, listening to his heart, and finding his true purpose.

books.title: The Psychology of Money
books.author: Morgan Housel
books.description: This book explores how human behavior, emotions, and personal experiences influence financial decisions. It teaches readers about saving, investing, wealth creation, patience, and making better decisions with money

books.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
books.author: J.K. Rowling
books.description: The story follows Harry Potter, an orphaned boy who discovers that he is a wizard. He enters Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, makes new friends, learns magic, and uncovers a mysterious secret about his past.

reviews.author: Robert Kiyosaki
reviews.reviewTitle: A Life-Changing Guide to Financial Freedom
reviews.comment: This book provides a different perspective on money, savings, and investments. It explains the importance of financial education and teaches readers how to build assets instead of depending only on a salary. A very useful book for anyone who wants to improve their financial knowledge.

reviews.author: James Clear
reviews.comment: Atomic Habits is an inspiring book that explains how small improvements can lead to significant changes in life. The author provides practical techniques for developing good habits and eliminating bad ones. It is easy to understand and highly useful for personal growth.

reviews.author: Morgan Housel
reviews.reviewTitle: Understanding the Real Meaning of Wealth
reviews.comment: This book offers valuable lessons about money, financial decisions, and human behavior. It explains that becoming wealthy is not just about earning more but also about managing money wisely. The real-life examples make financial concepts interesting and easy to understand.
